notes_for_editor: Single source: the state index. Its entry gives 676 ft (206 m), Decatur 8-5, removed; the record's elevation and county agree. Searches and cache checks found no build date, builder, staffing, fire history, register listing or site description. Brief record had no status; facts.status set to gone per the index. A Turnbow community near Decaturville appears in the Decatur County history at tngenweb.org/decatur/history/; no source ties it to this tower, so it is not used. Record coordinates (35.5102, -88.1279) were not checked against a second source. Access left unknown.
